_schema: Defect reference for one ABAP source. Report-agnostic: it describes the
source, not any report, so it stays valid as reports change.
source   the file these defects were read out of, relative to Test-source/real
id        stable identifier, referenced by verdict files
area      which part of the program the defect lives in
question  phrased so a judge can decide yes/partial/no from the
report text alone, without guessing at intent
anchor    the source text that makes the defect checkable; some
Score a report with:  python scripts/evaluate.py score --defects THIS.json \

defects.question: yes/no: /ui2/cl_json=>deserialize is called with no TRY/CATCH in PARSE_RESPONSE and LIST_MODELS, so a provider error body (HTML page, truncated JSON, {"error":...}) raises an unhandled exception and dumps the report instead of returning a degraded answer?

defects.question: yes/no: escape_json escapes only backslash, double quote, CR/LF, form feed and tab, leaving the remaining C0 control characters (and it is applied to arbitrary reviewed source) unescaped, so a source line containing e.g. a vertical tab produces a malformed JSON request body?

REPLACE ALL OCCURRENCES OF cl_abap_char_utilities=>horizontal_tab IN rv_text WITH '\t'.
  ENDMETHOD.
